title: BGMI 4.7 goes live 18 Nov 2026 (Krafton India, announced 10 Nov) with Arctic Chronicles: Jormungandr reshapes terrain on Erangel, Livik and Vikendi until 18 Jan 2027 (horn wakes it, tail raises a hidden tower, new routes and hiding spots); Erangel Subzero ranked 3 Dec, Snow Festival 17 Dec, New Year sky countdown 31 Dec 8 PM IST. BGMI Air (lighter BGMI) launches 10 Dec on Android and iOS: about 1 GB first download, existing BGMI accounts work without transfer, 14 million+ Google Play pre-registrations before the date was set, iOS pre-registration opened 11 Nov
